ownerStatement: Approve SYNTIZ 0.1.1-experimental, the same sound for less ColdFire time, for this exact source, keeping 0.1.0's UI captures.
reason: SYNTIZ 0.1.1 (#1978) renders the same samples as 0.1.0 for less ColdFire time: bit-exact over 5.8 million samples on the host and 2.9 million on the emulator. The #2043 cost procedure ran on a base 0.8 development twin (678843cc) on the owner's MKII: the first copy costs 18.6 points against 0.1.0's 27.5 and each further copy 5.5; it was admitted on an empty pattern at 56.0 % and on a medium one at 95.4 % (first reading 97.7 %), with no render dropped and no stall (evidence/frame-cost.json). On that busy scene (Dev17 C04, stock alone at 81.5 %) a second copy already reads 105.6 % of the frame and four copies 112.4 %, so several SYNTIZ tracks still need a pattern with room. Its controls, pages and labels are unchanged from 0.1.0, whose captures are retained. Not run on this build: the test procedure's screenshots, the MAIN/CUE recording and a listening check, the flashed base and an MKI; no static cycle bound exists.
